EmailTemplate.subject: We are waiting to hear from you regarding your case number {!Case.Case_Number__c}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {!Contact.FirstName}, We’re here to help We're following up as we sent you an email 3 days ago requesting additional information for Customer Care Case {!Case.CaseNumber}. As we haven’t heard back from you, let us know if you need more time or If you're having trouble finding the email we sent. If we don't hear from you within 7 days, your case will be closed automatically. We're committed to resolving your case quickly and efficiently. Kind Regards, Qantas Customer Care
We look forward to hearing from you soon.
